# Code of Conduct

SunBridge is a small project kept by one maintainer. Everyone who takes part,
in issues, pull requests, reviews and any other project space, agrees to
this.

## Expected

- Be kind, patient and specific. Many people here are new to Home Assistant
  or to their inverter, and every question is a fair one.
- Assume good faith, and criticise ideas and code, never people.
- Respect other people's time: search the docs and the existing issues
  before opening one, and stay on topic.
- Respect privacy: never post someone else's serials, addresses or data.

## Not accepted

- Harassment, insults, slurs, or personal or political attacks.
- Sexual language or imagery, and unwelcome attention.
- Publishing anyone's private information without their explicit consent.
- Spam, and posts written to promote something rather than to help.

## Reporting

Report a problem privately to the maintainer through a
[private report](https://github.com/CaputoDavide93/SunBridge-Growatt-Home-Assistant/security/advisories/new)
with "Code of conduct" in the title, or with GitHub's **Report content**
on the post itself. Reports are read in confidence.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may edit, hide or delete comments, close or lock threads, and
block people who do not follow this code, temporarily or for good, in
proportion to what happened.

This code is adapted from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/),
version 2.1.
